shots.shot_type_other: first-person VR gameplay capture (American football game in a stadium)
shots.focal_element: the player's two gloved virtual hands raised to receive the snapped ball
shots.typography: small white sans-serif disclaimer, regular weight, sentence case, bottom-centre; stadium signage is in-game art, not overlay text
shots.what_happens: POV inside a VR football game: the line sets, the ball is snapped and the gloved hands close around it (a green catch highlight appears); the sung lyric 'all about the hype' (w63-w65) runs over it and impact/swoosh SFX x009 and x010 land inside the shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Drop a 1.1 s full-bleed first-person gameplay clip on a hard cut and overlay a small centred 'Captured on PC.' disclaimer at about 30% opacity near the bottom edge.

shots.focal_element: a man gripping both Touch controllers, with the centred caption
shots.typography: white rounded geometric sans, semi-bold, all lowercase except the product name, normal tracking, centred mid-frame with no backing plate (font guess, low confidence: Meta's Optimistic display)
shots.what_happens: A 0.34 s live-action flash: the keyframe shows a man in a kitchen crouched and pumping the controllers, while the single sheet frame shows a tighter shot of a bearded man's chest and a controller; the caption 'with TruTouch haptics' appears and swoosh SFX x011 lands on the cut.
shots.build_rebuild: Hard-cut to a sub-half-second live-action clip of hands on controllers and fade in a centred white semi-bold lowercase caption that persists across the next cut.

shots.focal_element: two hands squeezing white Touch Plus controllers in close-up
shots.typography: same caption as s024: white rounded geometric sans, semi-bold, lowercase, centred mid-frame, no plate
shots.what_happens: Close-up of a bearded man's hands and wrist strap as he grips and squeezes the controllers against a defocused shelf; the 'with TruTouch haptics' caption holds in place, carried over from s024. The last sheet frame (0:43.0) shows a wide shot of the man wearing the headset and swinging his arm in a kitchen.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut to a shallow-depth-of-field close-up of hands on the controllers and keep the same centred caption layer, unchanged in position, running across both clips so the text bridges the cut.

shots.focal_element: a man wearing the Quest 3 headset mid-throw in a kitchen
shots.what_happens: A 0.42 s wide shot (keyframe) of the man in the headset winding up a throwing motion with a controller, which shows the real-world action behind the gameplay. The only sheet frame (0:43.5) instead shows the VR football stadium POV, so what fills this shot is uncertain.
shots.build_rebuild: Insert a 0.4 s wide live-action shot of the user performing the in-game throw, framed off-centre, on a hard cut between the gameplay clips.

shots.shot_type_other: first-person VR gameplay capture (American football game in a stadium)
shots.focal_element: the gloved virtual hand stiff-arming a defender
shots.typography: small white sans-serif disclaimer, regular weight, sentence case, bottom-centre
shots.what_happens: Back in the VR football POV, the player runs upfield and the gloved hand shoves a defender in the facemask under a stormy stadium sky; swoosh SFX x012 lands here. The second sheet frame (0:44.5) already shows the next live-action shot with the 'or just use your hands' caption.
shots.build_rebuild: Hard-cut back to about 1.2 s of first-person gameplay matched to the action from the live shot before it, with the same bottom-centre 'Captured on PC.' disclaimer.

shots.focal_element: hands setting both controllers down on a round wooden side table
shots.typography: white rounded geometric sans, semi-bold, all lowercase, normal tracking, centred mid-frame with no plate, same style as the TruTouch caption
shots.what_happens: Close-up of a woman's hands putting the controllers down on a wooden table under the caption 'or just use your hands', which introduces hand tracking. The final sheet frame (0:46.0) shows a wide shot of her in the headset pointing in the air with bare hands, the controllers left on the table.
shots.build_rebuild: Show a close-up of the controllers being put down on a table with a centred lowercase caption, then reveal the wider shot of bare-hand interaction once the caption has been read.
